snippet.title: Jackal - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
BUY NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124230/Jackal/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=launch

Become a coked up Vegas hitman in a blood-soaked fusion of Hotline Miami and Fear & Loathing, delivering brutal executions and relentless close-combat.

The highly anticipated top-down shooter from the legendary indie game developer Michał Marcinkowski, creator of Soldat and Maniac. Jackal merges the relentless brutality of Hotline Miami with a Tarantino-esque narrative set against the gritty backdrop of 1970s Las Vegas.

"Jackal combines my love of John Wick fight scenes, Scorsese's mobsters, Tarantino's storytelling, and the soul of the 1970s," says the creator Michał Marcinkowski.

BUY NOW ON STEAM!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124230/Jackal/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=launch
